name: Tasty Dairy Specialities Limited
about: Tasty Dairy Specialities Limited engages in the procurement and processing of milk in India. The company offers dairy products, including full cream, skimmed, toned, T-Special, butter, and pasteurized liquid milk; white and table salted butter; and desi ghee, paneer, peda, gulab jamun mix, chenna powder, and dairy delight products under the UJJWAL, SHIKHAR, VERIFRESH, CIMA, and MITHAI MASTER brands. It serves food products manufacturing companies, government organizations, co-operative societies, defense sector, retail outlets, etc. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Kanpur, India.
